Lemma
[The differential of the polar map]

↗ def:polar-map ↗ lem:mfderiv-open-inclusion

For $(r,\omega )\in \mathbb R^+\times S^{n-1}$ and $(a,w)\in T_r\mathbb R^+\oplus T_\omega S^{n-1}$, \[ d\Phi _{(r,\omega )}(a,w)=a\omega +r\, d\iota _\omega (w). \]

Proof

\sketch Differentiate the two factors separately: the radial map contributes $a\omega $ and the fixed-radius scaling contributes $r,d\iota _\omega (w)$.

□
